name: Uh Ah! Capybara
source:
Elli Marandici, a talented puppeteer, arrives in Bathrovico in the midst of her wandering, but is accidentally caught in a coup that threatens to claim the emperor's life. Deemed the primary suspect, Elli must pull out all the stops to get herself out of trouble. Fortunately, she does not have to fight alone: with the timely aid of four charming men, she may just be able to locate the culprit and prove her innocence before her time runs out. She may even find love on the way -- but would she live to savour it, or would the romance end up costing her her life?

Features

- Four potential GxB romance interests
- One sexy but elusive capybara
- Hand sketched sprites and CGs
- Meaningful choices (with a few not so meaningful ones)
- Multiple endings for each route
- Over 20 CGs and 30 collectibles (and counting)

[From [url=https://capyhaha.itch.io/uhahcapybara]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃利·马兰迪奇 (Elli Marandici) 是一位才华横溢的木偶师，在流浪期间抵达巴斯罗维科，却意外卷入一场威胁皇帝生命的政变。埃莉被认为是主要嫌疑人，她必须使出浑身解数才能摆脱困境。幸运的是，她不必孤军奋战：在四个迷人男人的及时帮助下，她也许能够在时间耗尽之前找到罪魁祸首并证明自己的清白。她甚至可能会在路上找到爱情——但她会活下去品味它，还是浪漫最终会夺走她的生命？

特点

- 四个潜在的GxB浪漫兴趣
- 一只性感但难以捉摸的水豚
- 手绘精灵和CG
- 有意义的选择（有一些不太有意义的选择）
- 每条路线有多个结局
- 超过20个CG和30个收藏品（还在增加中）

[来自[url=https://capyhaha.itch.io/uhahcapybara]itch.io[/url]]
